setup: Qwen3-8B reads every question wrapped in its chat template:
key: Orange: the 12 chat-template tokens. In the highlighted row the fine-tune is switched off at exactly these tokens; it stays on for the question and for every word of the answer.
col_answer: One answer to this question (same random draw in every row)
col_broad: Misaligned answers 8 everyday questions; should drop
col_narrow: Risky money advice the trained habit; should stay
row_template_sub: fine-tune off at the 12 orange tokens only
row_postfix: Off at the 9 orange tokens after the question
row_lastk: Off at the last 12 question tokens
row_rand_sub_short: control: all {nq} question tokens + first {ng} answer tokens
